name: Q*Bird
description: Q*Bird is a quantum communication company offering Measurement-Device-Independent Quantum Key Distribution (MDI-QKD) systems under the Falqon® product line. The company provides the highest level of QKD security by removing the detector side-channel attack surface. Q*Bird was spun out of QuTech (TU Delft / TNO) and received an EIC Accelerator grant and equity investment totalling €7.5M in 2025–2026.
funding: €7.5M EIC Accelerator (€2.5M grant + €5M equity, signed January 2026); €1M EFRO grant March 2025

news.title: Q*Bird Receives EIC Accelerator Funding for Quantum Secure Communications
news.excerpt: Q*Bird has signed an EIC Accelerator 2025 agreement securing €2.5 million in grant funding and €5 million in equity to scale its MDI-QKD-based quantum secure communication technologies in Europe. The NEXUS project will enhance MDI-QKD hardware efficiency, expand production capacity, and develop orchestration software for multi-operator quantum networks.

news.title: Falqon Systems launches Falqon 5000 Series for quantum secure networks
news.excerpt: Falqon Systems (formerly Q*Bird) launched the Falqon 5000 Series, the next generation of its MDI-QKD portfolio after the 4000 Series, comprising a Connectivity Hub (CH5000), QKD Node (QN5000) and Quantum Optical Switch (QOS5000) with support for ETSI GS QKD 004, 014 and 020 and SKIP. Forschungszentrum Jülich is the launch customer and will study QKD integration into power system communication networks.

news.title: QuTech spinout Q*Bird rebrands to Falqon Systems
news.excerpt: Delft-based Q*Bird, spun out of QuTech and TU Delft in 2022, renamed itself Falqon Systems as it shifts from hardware components to deploying end-to-end quantum secure networks, grouping its products under the Falqon brand (MDI-QKD Series, Key Manager, Domain Controller). Ownership, leadership under CEO Ingrid Romijn, customer contracts and roadmap are reported as unchanged.
